clue.text: Martians at last on flying saucer — that's deliberate

parts.note: a discus is the plate-shaped object an athlete sends flying, a saucer that really flies

indicators.note: at last points to the closing letter of the word Martians

explanation.surface: Little green men finally arrive on a UFO, and the narrator remarks that it was all intentional.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flying saucer' looks like a UFO beside the Martians, but it is the athletics discus. Here 'deliberate' is a verb, not the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: To deliberate is to weigh something up and talk it over, which is a synonym for debating a matter.

clue.text: Catch-22 upset cover girl

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the word for cover upside down, so it reads backwards

parts.note: a lid is a cover for a pot or box
Emma is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A paradox has upset a magazine cover model.
explanation.walkthrough: Only 'cover' is turned by 'upset'; EMMA follows unchanged.
explanation.definitionFit: Catch-22, from Joseph Heller's novel, names a no-win situation where every option is bad: a quandary.

clue.text: Try to catch a little pig

indicators.note: to catch means the word for try holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: a shot is an attempt, as in have a shot at it

explanation.surface: An instruction to grab a small piglet.
explanation.definitionFit: A shoat is a young pig that has recently been weaned, so a small porker.

clue.text: Excited to be designing puzzles? It's traumatic

parts.note: being up means being lively or worked up
setting is the crossword compiler's job of making puzzles

explanation.surface: A setter asks whether the thrill of compiling crosswords is in fact distressing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something distressing that shakes a person emotionally is traumatic in the everyday sense.

clue.text: Thrifty spouse acquiring collar finally for boxer

indicators.note: acquiring means the word for thrifty takes a letter into itself

parts.note: sparing means economical or frugal

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word collar

parts.note: a partner is a husband or wife

explanation.surface: A frugal husband or wife buys a collar for the family dog, a boxer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boxer' suggests the dog breed alongside the collar, but it is a fighter in the ring.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxer who trains with a champion in practice bouts is that fighter's practice opponent.

clue.text: See 12
Dance music on game shows

indicators.note: shows means the letters are on display within the words music on game

explanation.surface: Dance tunes are played on television quiz programmes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shows' looks like a noun (game shows) but is a verb, displaying the answer within the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: The conga is a Latin American dance performed in a long line of people.

clue.text: Chaste girl, one protected by mother, supplies element

indicators.note: protected by means the following pieces sit inside the word for mother

parts.note: mum is the British informal word for mother
Agnes is a girl's name; St Agnes is the patron saint of chastity and her name comes from the Greek for pure
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A pure young woman, sheltered by her mother, provides something elemental.
explanation.definitionFit: Magnesium is a chemical element, the light silvery metal numbered 12 in the periodic table.

clue.text: Rebellious as well, ordered south

indicators.note: ordered means the letters of as well are rearranged into a new sequence

parts.note: S is the compass abbreviation for south

explanation.surface: Insubordinate troops, too, were sent south.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who ignores the rules and defies authority is unruly, the sense of rebellious here.

clue.text: Evidence no longer in circulation wasted on tabloids

indicators.note: wasted means the letters of on and tabloids are wrecked and rearranged

explanation.surface: A forensic clue past its usefulness is squandered on the gutter press.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no longer in circulation' sounds like an out-of-print paper, but it is blood that has left the body's circulation: a cryptic hint inside the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A mark of spilt blood is crime-scene evidence, and that blood is no longer flowing through veins.

clue.text: Good to have ceremonial robe

parts.note: to own something is to have it

explanation.surface: It is good to possess formal vestments.
explanation.definitionFit: A gown is a long formal garment worn by graduates, judges or clergy on official occasions.

clue.text: Blue material turning stomachs

indicators.note: turning means the word for stomachs is read backwards

parts.note: tums is a childish word for stomachs

explanation.surface: Rude content that makes people feel sick.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue means indecent or risqué, so blue material is obscene matter, pornography.

clue.text: Under attack, extremely tough Red Guards scoffed

indicators.note: extremely points to the two end letters of the word tough
Guards means the word Red holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: taken as written
to scoff is to eat greedily, so scoffed means eaten

explanation.surface: Assailed by hardline Red Guards from Mao's China, someone was mocked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scoffed' looks like mocked but means eaten greedily.
explanation.definitionFit: Being menaced with danger or harm is being under attack, the passive sense of this verb.

clue.text: Beast involved in Bataclan crime

indicators.note: involved means the letters of the two words are tangled together into a new order

explanation.surface: An animal implicated in a crime at the Bataclan, the Paris concert hall.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the two-humped camel of Central Asia, a large animal or beast of burden.

clue.text: Keen soldier in WWI battlefield?

parts.note: the trenches were the battlefield of the First World War Western Front
a soldier ant is a worker of the warrior caste in an ant colony

explanation.surface: An enthusiastic serviceman fighting on the Western Front.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Keen' looks like an eager soldier, but it means sharp; the soldier is an insect, found in a trench.
explanation.definitionFit: Keen in the sense of sharp or incisive, as cutting criticism is pointed and forceful.

clue.text: Desire shown where t-shirt ripped

indicators.note: ripped means the letters of t-shirt are torn apart and put back in another order

explanation.surface: Lust is revealed where a torn top exposes a muscular body.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong craving or longing for something is a desire, as in a hunger for knowledge.

clue.text: Gabby — endlessly demanding girl about five

indicators.note: endlessly means the word for demanding loses its last letter

parts.note: tall, as in a tall order, means demanding or hard to meet

indicators.note: about means the girl's name goes round the next piece

parts.note: Katie is a girl's name
the Roman numeral for five is V

explanation.surface: A chatty, perpetually needy girl of around five years old.
explanation.definitionFit: Gabby means inclined to chatter at length, a synonym for loquacious.

clue.text: Evil urge for a rotter

parts.note: bad means wicked or evil
to egg on is to urge someone

explanation.surface: A wicked impulse in a scoundrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotter is a dated British term for a scoundrel, and a nasty person is called a rotten one, like spoilt food.

clue.text: Banking controller one suffering at work?

parts.note: someone who ails is suffering, so one suffering is an ailer
on means operating or at work, as a machine that is on

explanation.surface: A stressed bank manager is someone who suffers in the office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Banking' suggests money, but it is an aircraft tilting as it turns.
explanation.definitionFit: An aileron is the hinged flap on an aircraft wing that makes the plane roll and tilt in a turn.

clue.text: Tree totally covers entrance to London thoroughfare

indicators.note: covers means the word for tree holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: a palm is a tree

indicators.note: entrance to points to the opening letter of the word London

parts.note: all means wholly or totally

explanation.surface: A tree completely shades the entrance to a London street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'London thoroughfare' reads as the definition, but London only supplies its first letter. PALL MALL is a street in London's St James's.
explanation.definitionFit: Pall Mall is a famous London road, home to gentlemen's clubs, so it is a thoroughfare.

clue.text: Soul hit remade is vulgar

indicators.note: remade means the letters of soul hit are put together again differently

explanation.surface: A remix of a soul chart-topper is crude.
explanation.definitionFit: Loutish means behaving like a boorish yob, coarse and ill-mannered.

clue.text: Refuse to handle medium number in police vehicle

parts.note: to black goods is for a trade union to boycott them, refusing to handle them
M is the clothing-size abbreviation for medium
an aria is a song, a musical number

explanation.surface: Someone declines to deal with a psychic number in a police van.
explanation.walkthrough: 'medium' suggests a psychic, but it is the size letter. To 'black' work is British union jargon for boycotting it.
explanation.definitionFit: A Black Maria is a dated British slang name for a van used to transport prisoners.

clue.text: Compare lighter alternative

definitions.meaning: to set one thing against another to see how they measure up
something used instead of a cigarette lighter to give a flame

explanation.surface: Comparing a lighter option, as in choosing between products.
explanation.definitionFit: A small stick that strikes a flame replaces a lighter; to pair things up for likeness is to compare.

clue.text: Heroin, gold and pounds in takings from robbery

parts.note: H is slang for heroin
Au is the chemical symbol for gold
L is the abbreviation for pounds sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Drugs, bullion and cash among a thief's loot.
explanation.definitionFit: A haul is the quantity of goods stolen in a heist, the loot or booty.

clue.text: Some island seized by Henry I?

definitions.text: Some island seized by Henry I?

indicators.note: seized by means the island word is held inside the following letters

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for henry, the unit of inductance
an ait is a small island in a river, especially the Thames

explanation.surface: A question whether King Henry I captured an island.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines as well: Haiti is an island country, here pictured as an isle grabbed by a king.
explanation.definitionFit: Haiti is a Caribbean nation occupying part of the island of Hispaniola, so an island state.

clue.text: Whale with teeth decapitated Spanish poet

indicators.note: decapitated means the poet's name loses its head, its first letter

parts.note: Federico García Lorca was a Spanish poet and playwright

explanation.surface: A toothed whale beheaded a Spanish poet.
explanation.definitionFit: The killer whale is a toothed cetacean, a hunter with sharp teeth rather than baleen.

clue.text: Trendy one in dentist treated for inflammation

indicators.note: in means the first pieces sit inside the rearranged dentist
treated means the letters of dentist are processed into a new order

parts.note: in means fashionable or trendy
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A fashionable person at the dentist being treated for swelling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'treated' makes TENDTIS from dentist; INI goes in after TEND.
explanation.definitionFit: This is swelling and pain of a tendon, a medical condition of the inflamed kind.

clue.text: Nick back on time brought to church

indicators.note: back means the word on is read in reverse

explanation.surface: A thief returns punctually and is taken to church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nick' looks like British slang for steal or arrest, but it is a small cut.
explanation.definitionFit: A nick is a small V-shaped cut or indentation, like a notch scored in wood.

clue.text: Wine presented by female is in right hand

indicators.note: in means the female word and is sit inside the letters for right hand

parts.note: a hen is a female bird

explanation.surface: A woman offers a drink held in her right hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhenish is wine from the Rhine region, especially hock, so a German wine.
